text: On trimming Novig scans: with the stall fixed, a full scan now reads ~11.8k books in about 4 minutes, so skipping far/hopeless markets would save only ~1.5 min and risks missing a market that turns +EV. I'm not cutting reads now. I'll revisit if scans go past ~6 min or Novig starts throttling (I see occasional RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED on the live feed; watching it).
